text: Regular Arena has two top decks, the Rye one-carry deck and Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola, and the matchup between them flips on Bari's and Oven's stars.
detail: At similar power with Bari at 8★ or less, Rye wins; at 8–10★ Bari–Oven wins. Since 2026-09-27 most of the top of at least one server has gone back to Rye, and Bari–Oven is described as the #1's tool for farming and locking in the top.

text: With every cookie built: defend with Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola at 8–10★ Bari and Oven, and attack Bari decks below 8★ with the Rye deck, Rockstar in the flex slot.
detail: Rockstar's shield lands inside Bari's first dive, where Grapevine's heal comes too late. Keep a stage preset with accuracy for evasion defenders.

text: Ruling (medium confidence): 'Rye beats Bari' holds in regular Arena only below about 8★ Bari at similar power; much of the evidence for it is Rumble.
detail: Rumble's +30% DR lets the Rye deck's tanks survive the dive; the same Rye deck that holds up to +6M in Rumble dies in 0.5 s in regular Arena. Regular-Arena-only evidence is one Season 5 upset (13.27M over 20.4M) and two server reports.

text: Ruling (medium confidence): Bari 5★ is a floor, not a win condition, against the Rye heal-tank decks.
detail: Below 5★ Bari decks lose to the Rye heal-tank and Crepe decks. From 5★ Soul Guidance covers two chargers, but same-power Rye still beats 5★ and 8★ Bari decks, and a Rye deck with an 8★ Rye beats a half-built 5★ Bari deck. At 10★ the Rye deck can't hold.

text: Arena gear preset: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces, Skill AMP + crit rate on weapons, crit RES + DR on armour, no accuracy or focus.
detail: Whoever casts first wins, so haste is non-negotiable for heal and shield decks (Bari dive decks sometimes drop it). Crit rate beats crit damage because opponents stack crit RES and Moon Rabbit cuts crit.

text: Captain Milk at merc Lv.4 with Armor Repair + Passion Pay, and keep Milk ATK #1.
detail: Armor Repair needs three tank-type cookies. The mirror match is decided by who set their perks.

text: No stats site covers regular Arena: every Arena ranking here rests on forum posts and screenshots.
detail: crumb.gg has no Arena board, and crumblehub's shared decks are mostly from August, before Princess Bari.

text: The Rumble top 100 run one team: Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Bari, Milk, Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb and Moon Rabbit, with King Choco Drop, Holy Baby Drop and Hot Doggie.
detail: The #1 defense on 2026-09-27 is exactly this, and 82 of the top 100 show only these cookies.

text: Ruling (medium confidence): 'turtle vs charge' is one team seen through hidden slots, not two decks.
detail: The game hides some defenders; every fully revealed top-100 team carries both the support core and, almost always, Oven and Bari. Empty slots are legal, so a few genuine 8–9-cookie defenses can't be ruled out.

text: The Season 1 buff (Charge +30% max HP, all +30% DR) is what makes the charge core work; expect it to change when the buff rotates.
detail: Oven went from unused to meta, and Bari decks win at 2–3★. Each Rumble season has its own passive.

text: Ruling (medium confidence): the Rye anti-charge deck is the mid-spec counter, not a top-end one.
detail: At similar mid spec it beats Bari decks (18.77M over 27M once); at whale top-end the buffed divers win, and Rye is on 6 of the top 100.

text: Power doesn't decide Rumble rank; the team, the gear preset and the perks do.
detail: Wear the arena gear preset, not the stage preset. Usage figures here are lower bounds because of hidden slots.

text: Top-100 season rewards need 3,000 points; tickets are capped at 5 free per day, with more at 1,000 mileage each.
